title: qLLM SQL Request
description: SQL dialect request (alongside Query IR). version omitted = latest dialect. Optional constraints (D23) are additive to credential scope (D21).

version.description: SQL dialect version. Omitted = latest (currently "2"). "1" is frozen (no set ops / QUALIFY).

constraints.description: Catalog field → scalar. Host should bind this map; do not let the model invent subjects. D23.

constraintMode.description: validate (default when constraints non-empty): abort on mismatched eq. inject: also force eq on source fetch.
